News.Title: Town of Next Edited v2.0.0 Beta 1
News.Subtitle: TONE 1st Anniversary!
News.Body: Base Game Version - Based on Among Us v17.4 Fixed - Fixed an issue where the configured Impostor count in Hide and Seek could differ from the actual number of Impostors - Fixed an issue where Hide and Seek could get stuck - Fixed an issue where the Impostor Vision setting had no effect on the Coven - Fixed an issue where the Viper's kill icon didn't appear on non-host modded clients - Fixed an issue where flipping pages in the Guess panel could cause it to freeze - Fixed several issues with CNO - Fixed an issue where certain task settings in Infection mode could prevent tasks from refreshing - Fixed an issue where the Archaeologist's artifact "Truth Slate" had no effect - Fixed an issue where obtaining the Admin role caused the player to survive - Fixed an issue where the Revenant's kill logic was incorrect - Fixed an issue where friend-code verification for EAC bans was inaccurate - Fixed an issue where the Lawyer would not switch roles when their Client was ejected - Fixed an issue where a Copycat that became a Jackal/Sidekick/Refugee and then died would have its role revert after the next meeting - Attempted fixes for the abilities of the Noisemaker, Detective, and Viper (please use with caution, as these require further testing) Changed - Added an explosion sound effect for the Blaster - Improved Dleks settings (from TOUM) - Improved kill detection for the Puppeteer's Puppet - Improved the admin info displayed by the Nick Hacker - Improved Lovers logic - Improved EAC detection logic - Improved performance for some roles - Changed RPC calls to Modded RPC calls - The Halloween Decorations option now supports all maps - Added support for +26 info - Adapted Role Draft to support the option for spawning a random killing-faction role - Changed the send-target switch key (Shift → Ctrl) ★ In Starlight, you can swipe up to switch the send target ★ Starlight now shares mod files with the Windows version Removed - Option: "Attempt to Hide the /vote Command" (use /cmd vote instead) - Removed the click cooldown on main menu buttons - Mod option: Enable Custom Map Decorations Added - Ghost role categories for the Neutral Faction and the Coven - Option: Neutral Faction and Coven ghost role count settings - Added a loading animation for the Host - Command: /preset upload - Uploads a preset to the mod server - Command: /preset load [preset code] - Loads a preset from the mod server - Command: /setrole [player ID] [role] - Assigns a role to a player (requires up permission) - Option: Investigative-type roles cannot use Guess - Option: Max reliable data-flag sends per second - Option: Max unreliable data-flag sends per second - Option: Role balancing for low player counts (Brave, Vulture, Doomsayer) - Mod option: Enable Map Vent Icons (from TOUM) - Mod option: Enable Command Help - Mod option: Enable TONE Menu - Option: Cursed Wolf's counter-kill only triggers on a standard kill - Option: Cleaner kill and cleanup share a cooldown - Option: Notify everyone in meetings if a Wraith is present - Option: The Balancer's Scale causes a simultaneous ejection if no one votes in a meeting Role Changes - Changed the Forensic's option "Chance to Learn the Killer" to "Seconds After Death to Reveal the Killer" - Added a new artifact for the Archaeologist: "Bell of Order" - The Archaeologist's artifact "Prophecy Scroll" has been renamed to "Purify Crystal," with improved effects - The Fury now requires a cooldown to enter or exit its Enraged state, during which it cannot move or kill - Merged Influencer into Super Star - Mini Crewmate is now a Modifier - Nick Hacker is no longer an experimental role Limited-Time Game Mode - Game Mode: Campfire Night (available until 15:00 Beijing Time on June 29) New Roles - Impostor Faction: Disruptor Removed Roles - Crewmate Faction: Influencer (merged into Super Star) You can use the /up command for free until 15:00 Beijing Time on June 22 — a generous gift from us to you! For full details, please check out our website!! You are the best, best, BEST crewmates!! Thank you! <3

News.Title: Town of Next Edited v2.0.0 Beta 2
News.Subtitle: Manhunt!
News.Body: Base Game Version - Based on Among Us v17.4 Fixed - Fixed an issue where the Philosopher would die even when Logos had not been ejected - Fixed an issue where being killed by the Double Agent's explosion would not correctly display the killer - Fixed an issue where the last survivor in Speed Run could not win - Fixed an issue where the President's kill cooldown would not decrease after certain roles' kills were revealed - Fixed an issue where the kick command could not be used - Fixed an issue where certain commands were unusable when the game language was not Simplified Chinese - Fixed an issue where the Viper's Dissolve time was incorrect - Fixed an issue where the Miner's tunneling could get them stuck outside the map - Fixed an issue where the number of remaining emergency meetings would not decrease - Fixed an issue where non-hosts using the Coven introduction command saw no effect - Fixed an issue where the Sabotage button appeared when entering or exiting vents even when the Host was unable to sabotage - Fixed an issue where the Doll Master's own appearance became incorrect after using Control - Fixed an issue where, with the "Unguessable Modifiers" option enabled, the Good Gambler's and Evil Gambler's panels would not display Coven members - Fixed an issue in Infection mode where infecting a player just as they entered a vent could leave them stuck inside it - Fixed an issue where the AFK Shield was being granted in non-standard game modes - Fixed an issue where becoming the Seer after the first meeting prevented them from receiving Seer information - Fixed an issue where the Cursed could not win - Fixed an issue where invisible players would become visible when using ladders - Fixed an issue where, on non-host modded clients, Cupid could not use the Protect button after choosing the Lovers - Fixed an issue where a jailed player could not be released after the Warden's role changed - Fixed an issue where a Decoy disconnecting would re-trigger a report - Fixed an issue where the "generate log" command had no effect on non-host modded clients - Fixed an issue where the Local Room mod would not function correctly - Fixed an issue where the number of available guesses was incorrect when multiple Doomsayers were present - Fixed an issue where the Lovers' status became incorrect after the Witch cursed one of them - Fixed an issue where the Concealer's ability, or other roles' Shapeshift abilities, could end prematurely before a meeting was called - Fixed an issue where the Skeld map decoration option had no effect in Among Us v17.4 - Fixed an issue where the meeting button would sometimes break prematurely or unexpectedly Changed - All roles can now be used on official servers - Coven roles can now see whether they are holding the Necronomicon - The "Cannot Use Abilities During Discussion" option now also restricts Guess - The "Cannot Use Abilities During Discussion" option now also covers the vote tally period - Improved wording on some settings - Roles from other game modes no longer appear on the Gambler panel - Improved logic for the Shroud, Instigator, Alchemist, and Wizard roles - Force-ending a meeting now triggers role effects Removed - Game Mode: Campfire Night - Option: Cannot Guess During Discussion (merged into Option: Cannot Use Abilities During Discussion) - Option: Show Meeting Start Reason Added - Support for entering more symbols - Wraith ability icon - With Role Draft enabled, related info is now sent multiple times - Role icons now appear when viewing settings in the Lobby - Faction info now appears in its corresponding faction color - Option: Faction That Wins via Sabotage - Option: Enable Coven Channel - Option: Balance Faction Settings - Option: Hacker Ability Cooldown - Option: Assassin Toggle Kill Mode Role Changes - Most roles based on the Illusionist have been rebuilt on the Shapeshifter framework (abilities are now activated via the Shapeshift button) - The Orator can now target multiple players with a Speech at once; the effect has been changed so the target's vote counts as 0 - The Knight can now see their target's role during meetings - Tasks belonging to Lovers who aren't both Crewmates no longer count toward the task total - The Drunk, Mini Crewmate, and Orator are no longer experimental roles - Players erased by the Erased can no longer evade the erasure effect by dying - The Necromancer can no longer imitate Logos - The Time Assassin cannot use Sabotage while Time Stop is active - If the selected player dies beforehand, the Balancer's Scale meeting will not be called - The Imitator has joined the Crewmate faction - After the Assassin makes a kill, they now turn invisible instead of shapeshifting Limited-Time Game Mode - Game Mode: Manhunt Operation (available until 15:00 Beijing Time on August 10) New Roles - Coven: Witch Doctor For full details, please check out our website!!

News.Title: Guy Fawkes Night
News.Subtitle: 英国传统节日
Body: Guy Fawkes Night is a traditional British holiday held every year on November 5. Also known as Campfire Night or Fireworks Night, it originated from the Gunpowder Plot of 1605, a conspiracy planned by the Catholic Guy Fawkes, who was executed after failing in his attempt to assassinate King James I.

People lit bonfires to celebrate the foiling of the plot, and over time this developed into traditions such as burning straw effigies of Guy Fawkes, setting off fireworks, and enjoying toffee apples. The holiday was established by an Act of Parliament in 1606.

In modern celebrations, likenesses of unpopular public figures are burned in place of the traditional effigy. Large bonfire events are held in places such as Lewes in England, while former colonies such as New Zealand and Newfoundland in Canada have also carried on the custom of celebrating with fireworks.
Postscript： Campfire Night will come roaring back on November 1!
